title: PHI: 764 of 764 answered rows, on the corpus the rival stagings were killed on
status_plain: PHI's op-graph was identified -- square, x87 exp, multiply by the rounded 1/sqrt(2pi), with a live-pinned subnormal publication flush -- and 764 of 764 answered rows matched. It is NOT on an erf substrate: there is no erf and no CDF in that chain. The corpus is the identification round's own: the ruled-out ledger records that the rival stagings were killed on those same live rounds, so the 764 rows are the target of the identification they score. The source's phrase is "answered rows", never "held out" or "fresh".

counts.ambiguity_note: "Answered rows" is not "held-out rows". The ruled-out ledger shows the divide staging was killed on round 1 and the strict stagings on 39 constructed window rows -- the same live rounds that produced the 764.
